label: NZEUG president announces GISList retirement
summary: Kurt Janssen, NZEUG president at the time, told mailing-list members that GISList was scheduled to close on 8 February 2013 and pointed users towards web forums and RSS. The January announcement records a shift in practitioner communications, not a verified date of technical shutdown.

sources.label: Kurt Janssen career and GISList account retained in NZ GIS History
